records.name: Component, editable and input bases
records.purpose: Options-API factories producing base components: class resolution with style registration, an editable value holder and an input base.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports createBaseComponent, createBaseEditableHolder, createBaseInput and the types ClassValue, StyleModule and BaseComponentOptions. createBaseComponent adds a cx method and registers the style module on mount; createBaseEditableHolder adds modelValue and defaultValue props, update:modelValue and value-change emits, dValue, controlled and filled; createBaseInput adds size, fluid and variant props and injects pcFluid. createBaseComponent mixes in createPassThroughMixin (passthrough.ts, ADR-077): the pt and ptOptions props, ptm, ptmi, ptmo, the pt:section:attribute attributes and the $parentInstance provide and inject, with an optional hostName in BaseComponentOptions (ADR-079). The global and default pt sources, usePassThrough, pt.hooks, the $attrSelector dataset and the ptmi id fallback are not implemented (ADR-080), so ptOptions has no visible effect yet.

records.name: Style sheet and component style registration
records.purpose: SSR-guarded style sheet instance and a function that registers theme variables, hidden-accessible, icon spin, box-model and component CSS.
